sources: webnn-workbench@6ec63b8eeeb846380e302afd82397025cb2fdedd docs/results.md (Runtime overlap; Explicit record of this pass)
caveat: All absolutes were taken while unrelated work saturated the CPU. The overlap flags hide JS command encoding behind GPU execution, and a saturated CPU inflates encode time, so the paired 1.22-1.24x is an upper bound for a quiet machine; the floor is the ~1.05x from batch pass alone. No quiet-machine number or projection is claimed.
